text:
Maria (Design): dropped a compact-mode mock for the routing policies editor. main concern: when rules collapse, the visual hierarchy is lost and the reorder handle blends into token pills. preview sim also doesn't indicate which rule matched.
Dan (Product): can you paste the mock? is this only compact or affecting canvas too?
Maria (Design): compact first, but patterns carry over. attached two screenshots. key asks: stronger reorder affordance, inline validation, and match-highlighting during sim playback.
Alex (Eng): backend only returns match_id + confidence today. cheap win: return rule name + short reason (<=140 chars). frontend can show highlight overlay during sim.
Sam (Frontend): propose a 4px left accent on the active rule during preview, animate 200ms. make a visible 16px grab icon on hover and increase hit area for touch. aria label: "Drag to reorder". CSS draft ok.
Lia (A11y): ensure SR announcements are full sentences e.g., "Rule 'Allow - billing' moved from position three to position one." use role=status + aria-atomic=true. focus outline must meet 3:1 and be 3px min for touch targets. color contrast: prefer #005EC7 for accents.
Maria (Design): inline validation copy suggestion: "Conflict with 'Allow - billing' Show conflict details" (CTA). prefer inline badges over global toast.
Dan (Product): agree, inline is clearer for support.
Alex (Eng): will implement highlight + inline badge next sprint. can someone file a GH issue with copy + a11y asks?
Maria (Design): filing now. @design-bot create issue: "priority-surface: compact rows visual hierarchy & validation UX"
design-bot: Issue created https://github.com/redwood-inference/routing-ui/issues/3502
Maria (Design): I'll update mock to #005EC7 and post updated images. can we review tomorrow 9am?
Dan (Product): yes, calendar invite sent. thanks!
